name: mohit-gujarati-portfolio-workspace
description: Scripts that run across the website (frontend), API (server) and mobile app (.mobile-build).

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix .mobile-build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix .mobile-build && node --check server/index.js
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
